s.I. Z jakich powodów możesz ubiegać się o: I. On what grounds you can apply for maternity benefit
s.Zasiłek macierzyński przysługuje Ci, jeż: You are entitled to maternity benefit if, during the period of sickness insurance or childcare leave:
s.urodziłaś/urodziło Ci się dziecko (lub d: you gave birth / a child (or children) was born to you,

s.przyjmiesz na wychowanie dziecko w ramac: you take a child in for upbringing as a foster family, except a professional foster family, up to the age of 7, and in the case of a child for whom a decision to defer compulsory schooling has been made, up to the age of 10.
s.II. Przez jaki okres możesz pobierać zas: II. For how long you can receive maternity benefit
s.Zasiłek macierzyński przysługuje za okre: Maternity benefit is due for periods that correspond to the periods of:
s.urlopu macierzyńskiego albo urlopu na wa: maternity leave or leave on maternity-leave terms:
s.20 tygodni (140 dni) – jeśli urodziło Ci: 20 weeks (140 days) – if one child was born to you / you took one child in for upbringing,
s.31 tygodni (217 dni) – jeśli urodziło Ci: 31 weeks (217 days) – if two children were born to you in one birth / you took two children in for upbringing,
s.33 tygodni (231 dni) – jeśli urodziło Ci: 33 weeks (231 days) – if three children were born to you in one birth / you took three children in for upbringing,
s.35 tygodni (245 dni) – jeśli urodziło Ci: 35 weeks (245 days) – if four children were born to you in one birth / you took four children in for upbringing,
s.37 tygodni (259 dni) – jeśli urodziło Ci: 37 weeks (259 days) – if five or more children were born to you in one birth / you took five or more children in for upbringing.
s.Możesz wykorzystać przed porodem do 6 ty: You can use up to 6 weeks of maternity leave and maternity benefit before the birth. Then you will take the rest of the leave after the birth.
s.41 tygodni, jeśli urodziło Ci się jedno: 41 weeks, if one child was born to you / you took one child in for upbringing,
s.43 tygodni, jeśli urodziło Ci się dwoje: 43 weeks, if two or more children were born to you in one birth / you took two or more children in for upbringing at the same time.
s.Jeżeli Twoje dziecko posiada zaświadczen: If your child has the certificate referred to in Article 4(3) of the Act of 4 November 2016 on support for pregnant women and families “Za życiem”, maternity benefit for the period of parental leave is due for up to:
s.65 tygodni, jeśli urodziło Ci się jedno: 65 weeks, if one child was born to you / you took one child in for upbringing
s.67 tygodni, jeśli urodziło Ci się dwoje: 67 weeks, if two or more children were born to you in one birth / you took two or more children in for upbringing at the same time.
s.Z zasiłku macierzyńskiego za okres urlop: You can use maternity benefit for the period of parental leave in one go or it can be divided into a maximum of 5 parts of any length. The last part of the leave can fall no later than the end of the year in which the child turns 6, and for a child taken in for upbringing – until they reach the age of 7, 10 or 14 respectively.
s.Ze wskazanego wymiaru urlopu rodzicielsk: Of the stated length of parental leave, each employee who is a parent of the child has the exclusive right to 9 weeks of parental leave. This right cannot be transferred to the other parent. Taking parental leave for at least 9 weeks means the employee-parent has used the leave from that part.
s.urlopu ojcowskiego – 2 tygodnie, nie dłu: paternity leave – 2 weeks, but no longer than until:
s.ukończenia przez dziecko 12 miesiąca życ: the child reaches 12 months of age – where a child was born to the insured person, or
s.upływu 12 miesięcy od dnia uprawomocnien: 12 months have passed from the day the adoption decision became final and no longer than until the child reaches the age of 14 – where the insured person adopts a child.
s.Z zasiłku macierzyńskiego za okres urlop: You can use maternity benefit for the period of paternity leave in one go or in no more than two parts, each of which cannot be shorter than a week.
s.wymiar zasiłku macierzyńskiego za okres: the length of maternity benefit for the period set by the Labour Code as supplementary maternity leave depends on: the week of pregnancy in which the child is born, their birth weight and the period of the child's stay in hospital.
s.urodzenie dziecka przed ukończeniem 28 t: birth of the child before the end of the 28th week of pregnancy – one week of supplementary maternity leave for each week of the child's stay in hospital until the end of the 15th week after the birth,
s.urodzenie dziecka z masą urodzeniową nie: birth of the child with a birth weight of no more than 1000 g – one week of supplementary maternity leave for each week of the child's stay in hospital until the end of the 15th week after the birth,
s.urodzenie dziecka po ukończeniu 28 tygod: birth of the child after the end of the 28th week and before the end of the 37th week of pregnancy and with a birth weight of more than 1000 g – one week of supplementary maternity leave for each week of the child's stay in hospital until the end of the 8th week after the birth,
s.urodzenie dziecka po ukończeniu 37 tygod: birth of the child after the end of the 37th week of pregnancy and their stay in hospital, provided that the child's stay in hospital after the birth lasts at least 2 consecutive days, the first of which falls between the 5th and 28th day after the birth – one week of supplementary maternity leave for each week of the child's stay in hospital from the 5th day until the end of the 8th week after the birth.
s.Zasiłek macierzyński za okres uzupełniaj: Maternity benefit for the period of supplementary maternity leave is available to both the mother and the father of the child. It must follow directly after maternity leave and is granted in one go. It cannot be divided into parts and cannot be split between the parents.
s.Zasiłek macierzyński za okres ustalony p: Maternity benefit for the period set by the Labour Code as the period of maternity leave, leave on maternity-leave terms, supplementary maternity leave and paternity leave is 100% of the benefit base.
Maternity benefit for the period set by the Labour Code as the period of parental leave is 70% of the benefit base.
s.Ubezpieczonej, która nie później niż 21: An insured woman who, no later than 21 days after the birth, applies for maternity benefit to be paid for the period corresponding to the full length of maternity leave and parental leave is entitled to maternity benefit of 81.5% of the base for the whole period of leave granted to her.
s.Zasiłek macierzyński za okres urlopu rod: Maternity benefit for the period of parental leave in the part available exclusively to the child's other parent, referred to in Article 182¹ᵃ § 4 of the Labour Code (9 weeks), is 70% of the benefit base.

s.powstała wskutek wypadku w drodze do pra: arose as a result of an accident on the way to or from work,
s.powstała wskutek wypadku przy pracy lub: arose as a result of an accident at work or an occupational disease.
s.Zasiłek chorobowy przysługuje przez okre: Sickness benefit is paid for up to 182 days, and if the incapacity was caused by tuberculosis or falls during pregnancy – up to 270 days. This period includes periods of uninterrupted incapacity for work and periods of previous incapacity for work if the break between the end of the previous and the start of the new incapacity for work did not exceed 60 days. Periods of incapacity for work before a break of no more than 60 days are not included in one benefit period if, after the break, the incapacity for work occurred during pregnancy.
s.Za okres niezdolności do pracy przypadaj: For a period of incapacity for work after the end of insurance, sickness benefit is paid for no longer than 91 days. This does not apply to incapacity for work resulting from undergoing the necessary medical examinations for candidates for cell, tissue and organ donors and the procedure of collecting cells, tissues and organs, or to incapacity caused by tuberculosis or occurring during pregnancy.
s.Łączny okres wypłaty zasiłku chorobowego: The total period of sickness benefit payment during insurance and after the end of insurance cannot be longer than 182 days, and if the incapacity was caused by tuberculosis or falls during pregnancy – no longer than 270 days.
s.Po jakim czasie przysługuje prawo do zas: After what time you are entitled to sickness benefit
s.Osoby podlegające ubezpieczeniu chorobow: People covered by compulsory sickness insurance acquire the right to sickness benefit after 30 days of uninterrupted sickness insurance, and people covered by voluntary sickness insurance – after 90 days of uninterrupted sickness insurance.
s.Do 30- i 90-dniowego okresu ubezpieczeni: The 30- and 90-day period of sickness insurance includes previous periods of sickness insurance if the break between them did not exceed 30 days or was caused by unpaid leave, childcare leave or active military service by a non-professional soldier.
s.Od pierwszego dnia ubezpieczenia chorobo: The right to sickness benefit applies from the first day of sickness insurance if the insured person:
s.jest absolwentem szkoły lub studiów wyżs: is a graduate of a school or university or a person who has completed education at a doctoral school, and was registered for sickness insurance within 90 days of finishing school or obtaining the university diploma, or completing education at a doctoral school,
s.podlega ubezpieczeniu chorobowemu obowią: is covered by compulsory sickness insurance and has at least 10 years of compulsory sickness insurance (including social insurance before 1 January 1999),
s.była posłem lub senatorem i do ubezpiecz: was a member of parliament or senator and was registered for sickness insurance within 90 days of the end of their term.
s.Od pierwszego dnia ubezpieczenia prawo d: The right to sickness benefit also applies from the first day of insurance if the incapacity for work due to illness was caused by an accident at work, an accident on the way to or from work, or an occupational disease.
s.Aby udokumentować, że prawo do zasiłku c: To document that the right to sickness benefit applies from the first day of insurance, the insured person should provide relevant documents, e.g.: a university diploma, employment certificates, a decision confirming an occupational disease, documents confirming that the incapacity for work was caused by an accident at work or an accident on the way to or from work.
s.Okoliczności, które pozbawiają prawa do: Circumstances that remove the right to sickness benefit
s.za okres niezdolności do pracy, który pr: for a period of incapacity for work that falls within the waiting period for the right to the benefit,
s.za okresy, w których ubezpieczony zachow: for periods in which the insured person retains the right to remuneration under the provisions on remuneration,
s.w okresie urlopu bezpłatnego lub urlopu: during unpaid leave or childcare leave,
s.za okres urlopu opiekuńczego przysługują: for the period of care leave under the Labour Code,
s.w okresie tymczasowego aresztowania lub: during pre-trial detention or a prison sentence, except where the right to the benefit arises from the sickness insurance of people doing paid work on the basis of a referral to work while serving a prison sentence or in pre-trial detention,
s.za cały okres orzeczonej niezdolności do: for the whole period of certified incapacity for work if the incapacity was caused by an intentional crime or offence, as established by a final court ruling,
s.za okres pierwszych pięciu dni, jeżeli n: for the first five days if the incapacity for work was caused by alcohol abuse,
s.za okres objęty zaświadczeniem lekarskim: for the period covered by the medical certificate if, during sick leave, the person does paid work or undertakes activities inconsistent with the purpose of the sick leave,
s.za okres, w którym zaświadczenie lekarsk: for the period in which the medical certificate became invalid as a result of a check on the correctness of certifying and issuing medical certificates.
s.Dodatkowe okoliczności, które pozbawiają: Additional circumstances that remove the right to sickness benefit due to an accident at work or occupational disease
s.Zasiłek chorobowy z tytułu wypadku przy: In addition, sickness benefit due to an accident at work or occupational disease is not paid where:
s.wyłączną przyczyną wypadku było udowodni: the sole cause of the accident was a proven breach by the insured person of the regulations on the protection of life and health, caused by them intentionally or as a result of gross negligence,
s.ubezpieczony, będąc w stanie nietrzeźwoś: the insured person, while intoxicated or under the influence of narcotics or psychotropic substances, contributed significantly to causing the accident,
s.ubezpieczony odmówił bez uzasadnionej pr: the insured person refused without justified reason to undergo a test to determine the content of alcohol, narcotics or psychotropic substances in the body, or by their behaviour prevented such a test from being carried out.
s.Okoliczności, które pozbawiają prawa do: Circumstances that remove the right to sickness benefit for the period after the end of insurance
s.Zasiłek chorobowy za okres po ustaniu ty: Sickness benefit for the period after the end of the insurance title is not paid to a person who:
s.ma ustalone prawo do emerytury lub renty: has an established right to a retirement pension or disability pension due to incapacity for work, regardless of the insurance/provision system under which the right was established,
s.kontynuuje działalność zarobkową lub pod: continues gainful activity or has taken up gainful activity that is a title to compulsory or voluntary sickness insurance or provides the right to benefits for a period of incapacity for work due to illness,
s.jest uprawniona do zasiłku dla bezrobotn: is entitled to unemployment benefit, pre-retirement benefit or pre-retirement allowance, teacher's compensatory benefit, or supplementary parental benefit,
s.podlega obowiązkowo ubezpieczeniu społec: is compulsorily covered by farmers' social insurance.
